scenes.processing: Silent H.264 faststart, 24 fps, source color tags retained. Desktop 1920x1080 CRF20; mobile 1280x720 CRF19. Accepted five-second circular loop phase retained: source frames106-219 followed by six frames blending source220-225 with100-105 at head weights0,1/6,2/6,3/6,4/6,5/6. No reverse motion, motion interpolation or new generation. WebP posters use encoded loop frame12 (0.5 seconds), chosen so the foreground petal does not cover the right swan eye.
scenes.quality: Independent equal-scale encode and mobile-cover comparisons selected CRF20 desktop and 720p mobile to retain visible upscale detail. Dense five-second chronology and seam frames show no black-frame interval or new gross morphing. Brief doubled swan contours/petals remain during the inherited 0.25-second overlap; not claimed ghost-free/perfectly seamless. Continuous normal-speed perception remains unverified.
scenes.upscale: User-supplied 1080p upscale of the accepted original. Upscale provider/model not independently verified; added apparent texture is not claimed recovered factual detail.
